SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Gramma r in Use 5.3.1 Order of Adjectives, part of Strand 5 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can we use words to create vivid pictures of a person or place? 2. Why is it important to order adjectives correctly?
